name: ACE Medical Inc
old_description: Ask us about our Senior Discount 5-10% off on Tuesdays depending on the item, Contact Us!
about:
ACE Medical Inc was founded in 2001 in Honolulu, Hawaii, as a family-owned and locally operated durable medical equipment provider. The business was established to serve the islands' home healthcare needs and has remained under family ownership since its inception.

The company supplies a broad range of home healthcare equipment, including mobility aids, walking aids, oxygen systems, CPAP and BiPAP machines, bathroom safety equipment, and medical beds. In addition to sales, ACE Medical offers rental options for many of its products, catering to both short-term and long-term needs. The firm serves individual patients as well as healthcare facilities across Hawaii and overseas, drawing on over 25 years of experience in the region.

ACE Medical primarily serves the home healthcare and durable medical equipment sectors. Its customer base includes elderly patients seeking mobility and respiratory support, as well as hospitals, clinics, and long-term care facilities in Hawaii and international markets that require reliable medical supplies. The company emphasizes a community-oriented approach, referring to its customers as 'ohana' (family).

The company differentiates itself through its family-owned, locally rooted model and a senior discount of 5–10% on Tuesdays. It highlights personalized customer service and long-standing local experience as key reasons customers choose ACE Medical over larger national chains.

about:
ACI Plastics Inc was founded in 1967 in North Little Rock, Arkansas. The company began as a source for plastic supply and fabrication and has since grown to operate four production facilities centrally located in the United States.

The company provides custom plastic fabrication services including laser cutting, CNC routing, and thermoforming (vacuum, pressure, and drape forming) for prototype and large-run production. It works with engineered plastics such as UHMW, nylon, acetal, PTFE, PVC, phenolic, and HDPE, as well as transparent, UV-resistant, and graphic-grade materials. Additional capabilities include screen printing, die cutting, vinyl lettering, and assembly.

ACI serves retailers, fixture manufacturers, sign and display makers, screen and digital printers, building and construction firms, food service operators, and government accounts. Its product lines range from ballot boxes and sign holders to slatwall displays, risers, and food displays, and it supplied COVID-19 barriers for schools, restaurants, and medical settings.

The company emphasizes prototyping and design support, fast turnaround, domestically sourced components, and a central U.S. manufacturing footprint as its key differentiators.

name: ACI Plastics South, LLC
old_description: Send us your details and we will get back to you as soon as possible.
about:
ACI Plastics South, LLC runs a post-industrial plastics reprocessing plant in Liberty, South Carolina. The company focuses on converting plastic scrap into reusable resins and compounds for automotive and industrial supply chains.

The facility provides size reduction, multi-layer separation, electrostatic and density separation, fiber and optical sorting, patented paint removal, compounding on twin- and single-screw extruders, blending, pelletizing, and full logistics. Annual capacities include 70 million pounds of size reduction, 35 million pounds of separation, 10 million pounds of paint removal, and 40 million pounds of compounding. Equipment includes nine grinders, two shredders, two multi-layer separators, an electrostatic separator, a density separator, a fiber separator, an optical sorter, six paint-removal tanks, three twin-screw extruders, one single-screw extruder, multiple ribbon and paddle blenders, and a dedicated fleet of five tractors with 20 box trailers and two bulk trailers.

Primary customers are automotive manufacturers and tier suppliers generating multi-layer instrument panels, door panels, and painted TPO, PP, ABS, and PC/ABS parts. The company also serves broader post-industrial plastic waste streams, offering closed-loop programs that return reprocessed pellets or certified compounds to the original molder.

ACI Plastics differentiates itself with a patented paint-removal process that meets Class A surface requirements, a commercialized multi-layer separation technology achieving over 99.98% purity, an A2LA-accredited lab certified to ISO 17025:2017, and a logistics operation that handles pickup and delivery. The firm states its closed-loop model reduces material cost below virgin resin pricing.

ACM Technik LLC operates an online store and remote coding service from Garner, North Carolina. The company focuses on Volkswagen and Audi vehicles, offering feature activations and performance parts through its e-commerce platform.

It also provides remote services such as DSG unlock procedures, matrix LED and laser light activation, and various coding adjustments that enable functions like drive-mode remembering, travel assist lane change, and hill assist patches. Orders are fulfilled directly to consumers, with financing options available through Affirm.

Customers are primarily individual owners of VW and Audi models seeking to unlock factory-restricted features or enhance vehicle performance. The service also appeals to independent shops that need remote coding support for MQB and MQB evo platform vehicles.

ACM Technik distinguishes itself by specializing in remote activation of features that are disabled on US-specification vehicles, such as full matrix LED functionality and advanced driver-assist functions, without requiring the customer to ship hardware.

about:
ACS Medical LLC opened in 2013 as a locally owned home medical equipment provider in Urbandale, Iowa, with a second location in Lincoln, Nebraska. The company was established to supply CPAP, BiPAP, and home oxygen systems to patients across Iowa and Nebraska.

The firm provides a range of respiratory equipment including CPAP, BiPAP, and ASV devices, mask systems, portable oxygen concentrators, lightweight tank systems, stationary home oxygen concentrators, and backup systems. Services are managed by a clinical staff of respiratory care professionals who coordinate with patients and physicians. A compliance-focused resupply program handles long-term mask and supply replenishment, and patient instruction is offered in both English and Spanish.

ACS Medical serves patients with sleep apnea and chronic respiratory conditions, working alongside physicians and insurance providers. Its primary markets include home medical equipment, durable medical equipment (DME), sleep therapy, and oxygen therapy across Nebraska and Iowa.

The company states its mission is to deliver high-quality, appropriate care in an ethical manner consistent with regulatory standards and community expectations. It emphasizes a goal of 100 percent adherence to sleep therapy through ongoing monitoring and follow-up beyond the initial 90-day period.

name: ACTIA Electronics
old_description: Precision Electronics Manufacturing. Built for Performance. Delivered with Accountability.
about:
ACTIA Electronics operates from Romulus, Michigan, as the North American electronics manufacturing arm of the international ACTIA Group. The facility serves as a dedicated site for electronic production targeting the North American market, providing Tier 1 and Tier 2 solutions for automotive and industrial sectors with high standards of quality and compliance.

The company delivers full lifecycle EMS solutions, spanning engineering validation, new product introduction, volume production, and aftermarket support. Core processes include PCB assembly (PCBA), box build assembly, mechanical and subsystem assembly, conformal coating, and supply chain management. Programs are characterized as high-mix, mid-volume, with an emphasis on traceability, precision, and speed.

ACTIA Electronics serves OEMs and Tier 1/Tier 2 suppliers across automotive, rail, aerospace, industrial, IoT, and energy sectors. The company highlights expertise in connected devices for home automation and power electronics, as well as aerospace solutions leveraging automotive-grade quality systems.

Differentiators cited by the company include IPC-A-610 certified inspection expertise with an internal trainer, proactive supply chain and production planning, PPAP support, and quality system alignment. The site maintains ISO 9001, ISO 14001, IATF 16949, RoHS, and ISO 27001 certifications, reflecting a focus on quality, environmental management, automotive standards, and information security.

name: ADI Inc
about:
ADI Inc. is a family-owned wire and cable business based in Chanute, Kansas. The company was founded in 1990 by Merrill Cunningham after he left a corporate role to purchase the distribution side of an existing operation. Cunningham and his wife, Wendy, ran the business together for years before passing leadership to their sons, Scott and Stuart Cunningham, who now serve as CEO and plant manager, respectively. The second generation also includes Scott’s wife, Staci, in accounting, and Stuart’s wife, Becca, as office manager.

The company operates as both a value-added distributor of electrical wire, cable, and related products and a manufacturer of custom electrical harnesses and battery cable assemblies. Its facility houses specialty equipment for wire bonding to create multi-colored ribbon cable, striping machines for parallel and spiral stripes, and crimping, cutting, and assembly stations for harness production. ADI also maintains a UL-certified respooling operation (E146138) and offers dyeing, printing, and custom packaging services. The harness department has driven the firm’s most significant growth in recent years.

ADI serves customers worldwide, shipping throughout the United States and internationally. Its client base includes buyers who need exact cut lengths — such as 653 feet rather than standard 500- or 1,000-foot spools — as well as original equipment manufacturers and industrial users requiring custom wire harnesses, battery cables, and bonded or striped wire products. The company’s willingness to accommodate non-standard quantities and custom configurations has underpinned relationships spanning more than two decades.

Cunningham started the business to run his own operation after a corporate career, and the company’s differentiation rests on personalized service, flexible order quantities, and the ability to deliver locally within a 150-mile radius. The family-owned structure is cited as a reason for the personal care and responsiveness that the firm emphasizes.

old_description: We unify custom metal fabrication, precision machining (CNC and manual), and UL508A-certified control panel building under one roof, providing a single point of accountability for your project.
about:
AEC Enterprises operates from New Virginia, Iowa. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure in the provided materials. It presents itself as a specialized engineering and manufacturing firm with a long-standing reputation in seed production equipment.

The firm unifies custom metal fabrication, precision machining (both CNC and manual milling and turning), welding, industrial painting, and mechanical assembly under one roof. It also builds UL 508A-certified control panels and designs robotic cells and complete automation systems. AEC produces its own line of seed processing machinery—including production shellers, precleaners, batch shellers, sizers, integrated fan/burner units, and conveying infrastructure—and accepts contract manufacturing work ranging from one-off components to full-scale integrated production lines.

Its customer base spans the seed and agricultural sectors, serving commercial production facilities and foundation seed laboratories, as well as automotive and specialized manufacturing industries that require custom automation, control panels, and robotic integration.

AEC emphasizes a single point of accountability by combining fabrication, machining, and control-panel building in-house. The company cites an execution-first approach focused on longevity and maintainability, end-to-end support from design through field startup, and the ability to scale from prototypes to recurring production runs as its core differentiators.

name: AFL - Cable
old_description: environments. As the leading world manufacturer of fiber optic cable, AFL is uniquely positioned to provide a full line of all-dielectric self-supporting (
about:
AFL operates from its headquarters in Duncan, South Carolina, with additional cable manufacturing facilities in North Grafton, Massachusetts; Monterrey, Mexico; the United Kingdom; and Germany. The company traces its flagship product, optical ground wire (OPGW), to 1984, when it introduced the first OPGW for high‑voltage transmission lines.

AFL manufactures a full range of fiber optic cables, including OPGW (AlumaCore, CentraCore, HexaCore), ADSS (standard, mini‑span, flat drop, aerial drop), high‑density premise cables (MicroCore, armored tight‑buffered, hybrid fiber/copper), and harsh‑environment cables for subsea, downhole, and LSZH sensing applications. The company also produces attachment hardware, splice closures, tools, and assemblies. All cables are made to order, and AFL’s engineering team customizes designs for each application, supported by on‑site training and installation oversight. To date, AFL has supplied more than 250,000 km of OPGW worldwide and serves customers in over 100 countries.

Primary markets include electric utilities (transmission and distribution), broadband and telecommunications, enterprise and data‑center networks, industrial facilities, hyperscale data centers, and subsea/refinery operations. Customers range from investor‑owned utilities and rural cooperatives to private network operators and offshore energy companies.

AFL emphasizes environmental stewardship: its cable plants are ISO 14001 certified, recycling rates for paper, wood, metal, and plastic exceed 85 percent, and a returnable steel‑reel program reduces waste. The company also targets a yearly carbon‑footprint reduction of more than three percent. These practices, combined with custom engineering and field support, form the core of its differentiation.
